prerequisite_to: Any size-uniform estimate of the physical-record average of sector-conditioned rough-charge generators
question: Does averaging the pure-gradient rough-charge generator without its measured-charge factor retain the physical logical-sector information?
frozen_model: Canonical square_graph(L), L>=3, 0<p<1 fixed, finite real h!=0, signed interior charge Q and occupancy parity H on the right logical cut. Use the exact p_eff and c of the registered pure-gradient reduction; no change of physical channel or observation.

registered_branches.boundary_only_signed_average: Sum F_0(Q)-F_1(Q) over Q without the measured factor exp[h M(Q)]. Factor the zero-field p_eff boundary edges and derive an all-size parity product and its fixed-h limit.
registered_branches.physical_signed_average: Retain c^E exp[h M(Q)] and sum Z_0(Q;p,h)-Z_1(Q;p,h) over Q. Compare the exact independent-edge parity expectation with the boundary-only limit.
registered_branches.physical_absolute_average: Keep the absolute value inside the Q sum, calculate its exact relation to Bayes risk, and replay only existing L3 p=.30,h=.10,.50 to show that the signed average is not the risk observable. Do not infer any all-size absolute bound from this control.

acceptance: Prove both signed all-size formulas, including an explicit bound for the boundary-only limit; state precisely why they cannot determine physical Bayes risk; verify both registered L3 cells below 1e-12.
verification: Exhaustively enumerate only the existing L3 square (6561 states) in two previously used cells, compare direct current weights, the reparameterized boundary generator, physical signed contrast, and physical absolute contrast.
claim_boundary: The unweighted boundary-only signed average is not a physical posterior average. The physical signed average is not the Q-wise absolute contrast that determines Bayes risk. No fixed-h thermodynamic decodability result is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop after all-size algebra and the two L3 replay cells. Do not collect another size, sample, fit or threshold.
outcome: The unweighted boundary-only signed parity ratio tends to +/-1 at fixed h!=0, while the physical signed parity contrast is (1-2p)^L and tends to zero. Bayes risk requires the Q-wise absolute contrast with the measured-charge factor retained; the L3 controls verify every formula but do not yield its thermodynamic bound.
